On it. Quick findings from initial traces: there's no infra-wide outage in our us-west-2 pool, but we see a tight feedback loop from a subset of PayStream's request patterns. Evidence suggests client-side retries are set to aggressive defaults in their recent SDK patch (no jitter, short fixed delay) and that produced a retry amplification effect against a hot shard (same model version / same routing key).

Recommendations to immediately mitigate (can be applied by either side):
1) Set client maxRetries=2 and use exponential backoff with jitter (base 200ms -> 200ms, 400ms, 800ms).
2) Limit concurrent inflight requests per upstream host (for PayStream, suggest concurrency cap = 20 for generation endpoints for 30m).
3) We can toggle a routing policy to spread PayStream traffic across additional capacity (we're patching route weights now).

Suggested quick patch for PayStream (example JS):

// PayStream SDK retry snippet (suggested)
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxRetries: 2,
  backoffStrategy: 'exponential',
  baseDelayMs: 200,
  maxDelayMs: 2000,
  jitter: true
});

If you cannot rollback immediately, apply the snippet as a hotfix. I'm attaching a short proposed mitigation patch that limits retries server-side for this customer until we complete the RCA.

I'll stand by on the bridge.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Kari — thank you for your patience and for rolling back so quickly. Summary of action items and next steps:

What happened:
- PayStream deployed an SDK update at 08:43 PT which changed retry/backoff defaults to aggressive fixed delays. That caused a retry amplification loop hitting the same routing shard and produced elevated 5xx/429 and timeouts.

Immediate mitigation performed:
- PayStream rolled back the SDK at 09:52 PT and disabled client retries.
- Redwood applied a temporary customer-level throttle and redistributed route weights at 09:40 PT.
- Marcus applied a server-side short-term retry limit for PayStream until the client patch fully rolled out.

Agreed customer-facing remediation:
- Redwood will issue a one-month platform credit for impacted customers (proposed in thread; awaiting sign-off).
- Joint SRE postmortem scheduled for 2026-05-20 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
- Redwood will publish a short guidance doc on recommended retry/backoff defaults and provide a hotfix snippet for PayStream SDKs.
